summary: Iteration 148: Tested Organization-based Access Control for Webinars. Backend: 13/13 tests passed (100%). All new org-based access control APIs work correctly including webinar creation with org_domains, room-info with org classification fields, guest-permission grant/revoke, attendees-classified endpoint, and permission auto-expire on meeting end. Frontend code review confirms all required data-testid attributes are present in WebinarPage.jsx (CreateWebinarForm) and WebinarLiveRoom.jsx (ParticipantsPanel). Playwright UI testing blocked by login authentication flow in headless browser.

issues: Playwright browser automation unable to complete login flow - credentials filled but Sign In button click does not redirect. May be related to session/cookie handling in headless mode.
